summary: Iteration 5 review — Photo Zoom Lightbox + Yearly Wrap + Search Filters (pages + date range) + Gratitude Trends + mid-flow affirmation banner. Backend: 53/53 pytest pass (42 regression + 11 new iter5). New coverage: /api/search with pages=10 returns only Journal(page 10) matches, pages=3 returns only Blessings(page 3), no pages returns all, from/to date range excludes older entries; /api/gratitude-trends returns {blessings:[{text,count}], goals:[{text,count}]} only for items repeated >=2 times, sorted desc, capped at 6 each (verified 3× 'My family', 2× 'peace of mind', excluded 'solo blessing'); /api/yearly-wrap?year=2025 returns entriesCount=3, photos=3, avgMood=4.0, moodCounts, workoutBreakdown={run:2,yoga:1}, bestMonth='2025-03', topWins sorted with 'ship v1' first, longestStreak/currentStreak, and defaults to current year. Regression: /api/init, PUT/GET /api/day/{d}, /api/calendar, /api/insights, /api/weekly-recap, /api/mood-trend, /api/on-this-day, /api/search (no filters), and auth register/login/me all pass. Frontend (Expo web, 390x844) with seeded uid TEST_i5_ui_1 (3 entries in 2026-09 with 'My family' blessing, 'ship v1' goal, 'peace' journal, 2 photos): Search screen renders both chip rows (filter-page-{all,journal,blessings,goals,workout,actions,ritual} and filter-range-{any,30,year}); typing 'peace' shows 3 result cards under All, filtering by Journal keeps 3 (all journals contain 'peace'), Blessings keeps 3, Last-30-days keeps 3. Progress screen shows Year-in-Review button (yearly-wrap-btn) and 'Recurring themes' card with 'My family' entry. Tapping Year in Review renders the shareable card (3 entries, 1 day logged, 1 longest streak, 😀 avg mood 4.3, 2 photos, Sep best month, 'ship v1' highlight), wrap-prev/wrap-next chips visible with wrap-next aria-disabled=true at 2026 (correct), Share button present, and tapping wrap-prev navigates to 2025. Added testID='affirmation-banner' on the mid-flow banner in /app/frontend/app/flow.tsx:466 — condition is `affirmationText && stepKey !== 'affirmations' && stepKey !== 'final'` which matches spec (banner appears near bottom on Workout/Journal/etc. but NOT on the affirmations picker step or final step). Photo lightbox code review: opens Modal on tap, ZoomableImage uses Gesture.Simultaneous(pinch, pan, doubleTap) via react-native-gesture-handler + reanimated (pinch clamps scale≥1, double-tap toggles 2.5x, pan only when zoomed, all reset when zoom≤1.05), horizontal paged FlatList still handles paging between photos, testID='lightbox-close' + dot indicators + backdrop press to close — matches spec. No deprecated Expo packages. No red screens.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:579-618 /api/search correctly parses pages=CSV → int set, applies to matches via SEARCH_FIELDS filter, and uses {'$gte':from,'$lte':to} for date range; empty q short-circuits to []. Matches spec.
server.py:789-809 /api/gratitude-trends de-dupes case-insensitively (lowercase key), preserves first-seen display casing, filters count>=2 and caps top 6 per field. Correct.

server.py:812-863 /api/yearly-wrap uses {'$regex':'^YYYY-'} on date, counts photos, tallies workoutBreakdown across List[str] workouts, dailyGoals+weekly.wentWell for wins, month_counts on entry.date[:7] → bestMonth, avgMood rounded to 1dp, includes longestStreak/currentStreak from compute_streak. Correct.

photo-lightbox.tsx ZoomableImage: pinch scale.value clamped to Math.max(1, saved*scale); on end, if scale<=1.05 reset+setZoomed(false); pan enabled only when zoomed; doubleTap toggles between 1 and 2.5. Uses runOnJS to sync JS state — correct reanimated pattern.

yearly-wrap.tsx: wrap-next is disabled and dimmed when year>=currentYear (line 68-72); ViewShot ref + captureRef fed to Sharing.shareAsync; falls back gracefully on web (empty catch). Web note shown when Platform.OS==='web'.
search.tsx debounces text→q with 300ms setTimeout and rebuilds filters via useMemo; PAGE_FILTERS 'actions' spans pages [8,9] (yesterday's + tomorrow's actions) — matches backend SEARCH_FIELDS 8/9.
profile.tsx:164-194 'Recurring themes' card gates on `gratitude && (blessings.length>0 || goals.length>0)`, correctly hides when no repeats.
flow.tsx:465-470 mid-flow affirmation banner shown when affirmationText truthy AND step ∉ {affirmations, final} — matches spec exactly. Added testID='affirmation-banner' for testability.
No deprecated Expo packages (no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch anywhere).
All new files <300 lines: yearly-wrap.tsx (197), search.tsx (200), photo-lightbox.tsx (159).
